package main

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "reflect"
 "sort"
)

type Case struct {
 Name string `json:"name"`
 Shards int `json:"shards"`
 Beta float32 `json:"beta"`
 MaxIterations int `json:"maxIterations"`
 Edges [][]json.RawMessage `json:"edges"`
 Placement map[string]uint64 `json:"expectedPlacement"`
 Communities int `json:"expectedCommunityCount"`
 Passes int `json:"expectedRefinementPasses"`
 TxAlloPlacement map[string]uint64 `json:"expectedTxAlloPlacement,omitempty"`
 TxAlloCommunities int `json:"expectedTxAlloCommunityCount,omitempty"`
 TxAlloPasses int `json:"expectedTxAlloRefinementPasses,omitempty"`
}
func run(c Case, txallo bool) (map[string]uint64,int,int) {
 labels:=[]string{}; ids:=map[string]int{}; counts:=map[[2]int]int{}
 add:=func(s string) int { if n,ok:=ids[s];ok{return n}; n:=len(labels);ids[s]=n;labels=append(labels,s);return n }
 for _,e:=range c.Edges { var a,b string; var n int; json.Unmarshal(e[0],&a);json.Unmarshal(e[1],&b);json.Unmarshal(e[2],&n); x,y:=add(a),add(b);if x>y{x,y=y,x};counts[[2]int{x,y}]+=n }
 g:=Graph{make(Edges,len(labels)),make([]WeightType,len(labels))}
 keys:=make([][2]int,0,len(counts));for k:=range counts{keys=append(keys,k)}
 sort.Slice(keys,func(i,j int) bool{if keys[i][0]!=keys[j][0]{return keys[i][0]<keys[j][0]};return keys[i][1]<keys[j][1]})
 for _,k:=range keys{g.AddDirectedEdge(k[0],k[1],WeightType(counts[k]));g.AddDirectedEdge(k[1],k[0],WeightType(counts[k]))}
 p:=make([]float32,c.Shards);for i:=range p{p[i]=1}
 l:=NewLouvain(g,p,false,c.Beta,c.Shards)
 l.Compute(true,!txallo,txallo)
 communities:=l.GetCommunitiesNum()
 l.CommToShard(c.Beta); _,placement:=l.UpdateNodeShardIndex();passes:=0
 for i:=0;i<c.MaxIterations;i++{var improved bool; improved,placement=l.NodeMerge(placement,!txallo,txallo);passes++;if !improved{break}}
 result:=map[string]uint64{};for i,s:=range placement{result[labels[i]]=uint64(s)}
 return result,communities,passes
}
func main(){
 data,err:=os.ReadFile("cases.json");if err!=nil{panic(err)};var cases []Case;if err=json.Unmarshal(data,&cases);err!=nil{panic(err)}
 stdout:=os.Stdout; null,err:=os.OpenFile(os.DevNull,os.O_WRONLY,0);if err!=nil{panic(err)};os.Stdout=null
 for i:=range cases{c:=&cases[i]; c.Placement,c.Communities,c.Passes=run(*c,false);tp,tc,tr:=run(*c,true)
 if !reflect.DeepEqual(c.Placement,tp)||c.Communities!=tc||c.Passes!=tr{c.TxAlloPlacement=tp;c.TxAlloCommunities=tc;c.TxAlloPasses=tr}
 for rep:=0;rep<100;rep++{p,cn,r:=run(*c,false);if !reflect.DeepEqual(c.Placement,p)||c.Communities!=cn||c.Passes!=r{panic(fmt.Sprintf("unstable P-Louvain fixture %s",c.Name))}}
 }
 os.Stdout=stdout;out,err:=json.MarshalIndent(cases,"","  ");if err!=nil{panic(err)};fmt.Println(string(out))
}
